name: Dakshina Kali Mantra
text: क्रीं क्रीं क्रीं हूं हूं हूं दक्षिणे कालिके क्रीं क्रीं क्रीं स्वाहा
meaning: An invocation of Dakshina Kali using seed syllables associated with her tantric worship.
purpose: A specialised fierce-form invocation rather than a general-purpose calming prayer.
supports: Reflection on fear, transformation and the fierce protective image of Kali.
when: Only within a practice where the practitioner has received appropriate guidance.
note: A bija-rich tantric mantra. It should not be presented as universally unrestricted; the spelling and pronunciation of bija syllables should be learned from a qualified teacher.
